title: Local authority district to combined authority, May 2025 (England)
description: Official ONS lookup from English Local Authority Districts to the combined authorities they belong to, as at May 2025. Districts outside any combined authority are not listed.

title: Local authority district to county and unitary authority, April 2025 (United Kingdom)
description: Official ONS lookup from Local Authority Districts to counties and unitary authorities in the United Kingdom, as at 1 April 2025.

title: Local authority district to LAU1 and ITL levels 3, 2 and 1, 2021 (United Kingdom)
description: Official ONS lookup from 2021 Local Authority Districts through Local Administrative Units to International Territorial Levels 3, 2 and 1.

title: 2021 LSOA to local authority district, May 2023 (England and Wales)
description: Official ONS exact-fit lookup from 2021 Lower Layer Super Output Areas to Local Authority Districts as at May 2023.

title: 2021 MSOA to local authority district, May 2023 (England and Wales)
description: Official ONS exact-fit lookup from 2021 Middle Layer Super Output Areas to Local Authority Districts as at May 2023.

title: Local authority district changes, December 2022 to May 2023 (United Kingdom)
description: Official ONS lookup from December 2022 Local Authority Districts to their May 2023 successors.

title: Local authority district changes, December 2024 to May 2025 (United Kingdom)
description: Official ONS lookup from December 2024 Local Authority Districts to their May 2025 successors.

title: 2011 LSOA to 2021 LSOA changes (England and Wales)
description: Official ONS lookup from 2011 Lower Layer Super Output Areas to 2021 LSOAs, with a change indicator: U unchanged, S split, M merged, X a complex redistribution.

title: 2021 LSOA to 2021 MSOA (England and Wales)
description: Official ONS exact-fit lookup from 2021 Output Areas to Lower and Middle Layer Super Output Areas, December 2021, stored at LSOA level: every 2021 LSOA lies wholly in one 2021 MSOA.
